messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the Console observability push next quarter. Customers want per-route cost breakdown, a tracing hook for high-p90/95 flows, and an errors dashboard tied to model versions.

maya: My 3-lane proposal: (1) Core dashboards (cost + errors), (2) Tracing hooks MVP (header-driven sampling + linkouts), (3) Cost attribution beta (aggregated token buckets per route). Need engineering + CS priorities.

aj: +1 to lanes. Two tradeoffs: sampling density vs storage cost, and full token logs vs aggregated counters. For tracing, use request headers to tag traces by model/version so we don't instrument every component.

leo: For sampling plan I recommend 1% global default, with adaptive bumps during error spikes. Ops note: expect ~20% storage uplift at 1% given our current QPS; I can run projections if we freeze target QPS.

sophia: Aggregation idea: avoid per-token writes. Maintain counters per route+model variant in time buckets (e.g., 1m). That gives near-real-time cost estimates and much lower write amplification.

caroline: CS: our three pilot customers require CSV export and slicing by customer-id + model-version. This is a gating ask for pilot participation.

nina: UX question: ship three focused dashboards or one unified surface? Focused is faster; nav can unify later.

maya: Proposed minimum acceptance criteria (draft):
1) Cost dashboard: per-route and per-model-variant 24h delta, CSV export, <5s query for 30d range
2) Errors dashboard: top-10 error slices by route/model, sample traces for each slice, alert template
3) Tracing hooks MVP: header-driven sampling, UI link to trace viewer, 1% default sampling with adaptive bump
Canary plan: 2 pilot accounts + internal traffic for 48h, dashboard queries must succeed >98% and latencies within target.

aj: Rough effort estimates: Core dashboards ~4 dev-weeks (2 FE, 1 BE, 1 infra), Tracing hooks ~3 dev-weeks, Cost attribution beta ~3-5 dev-weeks depending on aggregation.

leo: Infra tasks: retention policy tweak, index for per-route counters, sampler config. Risk: bad sampler config could spike IO; I'll own rollback/circuit breaker.

sophia: Data tasks: build aggregation pipeline, backfill support for pilot accounts, export API. Estimate 2 eng-weeks + 1 QA week.

caroline: Customers want pilot in 8 weeks. They'll accept alpha UX if CSV export and model-version slicing are present.

maya: If we need to meet 8 weeks, recommend cutting token-level raw logs and cross-customer merges. Ship aggregated buckets + CSV, traces header sampling, and error slices.

aj: Agreed — no per-token retention in v1. Add feature flags + per-account rollout controls.

leo: Canary rollout plan: internal staging 72h, opt-in pilot accounts (2) for 48h, then 10% rollout. Circuit breaker if query latency increases >30% or storage IO >25% above baseline.

nina: UX will provide a simple CSV schema, two widgets (time series + top-slice table), and a "view traces" link that opens trace viewer with filters. I'll mock this week.

maya: Decision? If everyone thumbs up I’ll add to roadmap (target M-2 for QA) and open PR for acceptance criteria.

aj: +1. Enforce the v1 cut (no raw token retention).

leo: +1. I'll prepare infra runbook and threshold checks.

sophia: +1. I'll draft pipeline spec and example queries.

caroline: +1 from CS; I'll onboard pilot customers and share checklist.

maya: Thanks all — I'll update the roadmap doc and schedule follow-ups. deploy-bot: deploy queued to staging in 30m for the tracing sampler config test. :thumbsup:
